The cutoff for a same‑day domestic wire is **4:00 PM Eastern Time**. Transfers initiated before this time on a business day will be processed the same day.

VaultSecure Bank charges the following fees for outgoing wire transfers:

- **Domestic wire transfer:** **$20** per transfer  
- **International wire transfer:** **$40** per transfer  

These fees apply to each outgoing wire, regardless of the amount transferred. If you have any further questions about wiring funds or need assistance with a specific transaction, just let me know!
The overdraft fee is **$30 per overdrawn item**. You can be charged this fee up to **three times in a single day**.

The Savings account at VaultSecure Bank earns a variable rate of **2.1% APY**. This rate applies to balances that meet the account’s minimum opening deposit requirement of $100. If you have any other questions about the Savings account features or how to manage it through online banking, feel free to let me know!
